```{.r .cell-code}
r.nlights <- rast("data/nightlights/NL.tif")
# load mexico boundary - can get from INEGI or rnaturalearth
mex <- geodata::gadm("MEX", level = 0, path = "data/")  # or use st_read() if you have a shapefile

# crop and mask
r.mex <- crop(r.nlights, mex)        # crop to bounding box first (fast)
r.mex <- mask(r.mex, mex) 

writeRaster(r.mex, 'data/nightlights/NL_mexico.tif', overwrite = TRUE)
r.mxlog <- log1p(r.mex)  # log1p handles zeros gracefully (log(1+x))
plot(r.mxlog)
```
